name: catalyst_fast_r2e_similarity_router_v1
purpose: Use complementary already-trained R2E representations instead of repeatedly training new families: route low train-reaction-similarity queries to EnzGFM+bounded-center and high-similarity queries to the current matched bounded-center baseline.

selection_boundary.selection_interpretation: Both are internal clean development/replication evidence. They are not treated as untouched confirmation after this router was selected.
selection_boundary.router_feature: max_train_drfp_tanimoto computed only against training reactions
selection_boundary.router_rule: use EnzGFM+bounded-center iff max_train_drfp_tanimoto < 0.9; otherwise use matched current bounded-center baseline

untouched_confirmation.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

confirmation_acceptance.if_pass: promote the router; report the observed deltas without inflating the claim
confirmation_acceptance.if_fail: reject this router with no threshold adjustment on the confirmation split
